panels.title: Model calls by provider
panels.query: count(spans) where gen_ai.system exists group by gen_ai.system

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.query: sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) group by gen_ai.request.model where gen_ai.system = 'gcp.vertex.agent'

panels.title: Tool latency p95
panels.query: p95(duration) where gen_ai.system = 'gcp.vertex.agent' and name starts_with 'execute_tool' group by gcp.vertex.agent.tool_name

panels.title: Agent invocations
panels.query: count(spans) where name starts_with 'invoke_agent' and gen_ai.system exists
